def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids); st = list(feats.stratum); levels = sorted(set(st))
    Z = np.ones((n, 1)) if len(levels) < 2 else np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [[float(s == l) for s in st] for l in levels[1:]])
    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False); R = np.nan_to_num(R)
    cache = {}
    def col(t):
        return X[:, t] if not isinstance(t, tuple) else X[:, t[0]] * X[:, t[1]]
    def ll(terms):
        key = tuple(sorted(terms, key=str))
        if key in cache: return cache[key]
        A = np.column_stack([Z] + [col(t) for t in key]) if key else Z
        b = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30); m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = m * (1 - m) + 1e-9
            H = A.T @ (A * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - m)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        eta = np.clip(A @ b, -30, 30); v = float(np.sum(y * eta - np.logaddexp(0, eta)))
        cache[key] = v; return v
    def pv(terms, t):
        return stats.chi2.sf(max(2 * (ll(terms + [t]) - ll(terms)), 0), 1)
    sel = []
    gates = [0.01 / p] * 25
    for g in gates:
        cand = [j for j in range(p) if j not in sel and all(abs(R[j, s]) < 0.6 for s in sel)]
        if not cand: break
        best = max(cand, key=lambda j: ll(sel + [j]))
        if pv(sel, best) > g: break
        sel.append(best)
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        worst = max(sel, key=lambda s: ll([t for t in sel if t != s]))
        rest = [t for t in sel if t != worst]
        if pv(rest, worst) > 0.01 / p: sel = rest; changed = True
    for i, s in enumerate(list(sel)):
        rest = [t for t in sel if t != s]
        clus = [j for j in range(p) if abs(R[j, s]) >= 0.6 and (j == s or all(abs(R[j, t]) < 0.6 for t in rest))]
        if len(clus) < 2: continue
        top = max(ll(rest + [j]) for j in clus)
        ok = [j for j in clus if ll(rest + [j]) >= top - 2]
        sel[i] = max(ok, key=lambda j: ll(rest + [j]) - (0 if j == s else 0.5))
    # product / square screen over all pairs
    base = ll(sel)
    A = np.column_stack([Z] + [X[:, t] for t in sel]) if sel else Z
    bb = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
    for _ in range(30):
        m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ bb, -30, 30))); w = m * (1 - m) + 1e-9
        bb += np.linalg.solve(A.T @ (A * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1]), A.T @ (y - m))
    m = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ bb, -30, 30))); w = m * (1 - m); r = y - m
    pairs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    P = np.stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in pairs], 1)
    Pw = P - A @ np.linalg.lstsq(A * np.sqrt(w)[:, None], P * np.sqrt(w)[:, None], rcond=None)[0]
    sc = (r @ Pw) ** 2 / (np.sum(w[:, None] * Pw ** 2, 0) + 1e-12)
    prods = []; alpha = 0.005 / len(pairs)
    for k in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]:
        a, b = pairs[k]
        if any(abs(R[a, c]) >= 0.6 and abs(R[b, d]) >= 0.6 or abs(R[a, d]) >= 0.6 and abs(R[b, c]) >= 0.6 for c, d in prods): continue
        mains = sel + [j for j in {a, b} if j not in sel]
        if pv(mains + prods, (a, b)) < alpha: prods.append((a, b))
        if len(prods) >= 2: break
    for a, b in prods:
        for j in {a, b}:
            if j not in sel: sel.append(j)
    keep = []
    for j in sel:
        others = [t for t in sel if t != j] + prods
        inprod = any(j in pr for pr in prods)
        if inprod or pv(others, j) < 0.01 / p: keep.append(j)
    sel = keep
    drivers = tuple(ids[j] for j in sel)[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in sel),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
